AMOUNT DUE FOR TAXES: TAXES DUE IN THE APPROXIMATE AMOUNT OF $6757.42 AS OF 10/27/26. SALE MAY BE SUBJECT TO SUBSEQUENT TAXES, LIENS, UTILITIES AND INTEREST SINCE 10/27/26. SUBJECT TO: ALL UNPAID MUNICIPAL TAXES, ASSESSMENTS, LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES; ANY SET OF FACTS WHICH AN ACCURATE SURVEY WOULD DISCLOSE; ANY RESTRICTIONS OR COVENANTS ON RECORD WHICH RUN WITH THE LAND; RIGHTS OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, IF ANY; ANY CONDOMINIUM LIEN PRIORITY PURSUANTS TO NJSA 46:88-21, IF ANY; ANY OUTSTANDING PUD OR HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATIONS DUES OR FEES, IF ANY; ANY OCCUPANTS OR PERSONS IN POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY, IF ANY; ADDITIONAL MUNICIPAL CHARGES,LIENS,TAXES OR TAX SALE CERTIFICATES AN INSURANCE, IF ANY; AND ANY SUCH TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCES PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES MADE PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE. THE AMOUNT OF UNPAID TAXES MUNICIPAL LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL TAXING AUTHORITY. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDANT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTIAN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAINS OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.** IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE MORTGAGOR, MORTGAGEE OR THE MORTGAGEE'S ATTORNEY. AS THE ABOVE DESCRIPTION DOES NOT CONSITUTE A FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION, SAID FULL LEGAL DESCRIPITION IS ANNEXED TO THAT CERTIAN MORTGAGE RECORDED IN THE HUNTERDON COUNTY CLERK'S OFFICE IN BOOK 3261 AT PAGE 590, ET SEQ.,NEW JERSEY, AND THE WRIT OF EXECUTION ON FILE WITH THE SHERIFF OF HUNTERDON COUNTY.
